title: Role
description: A named bundle of permissions, resolved for the caller. Composed onto the same access-grant base as permission.

code.description: Stable machine name, unique within the scope. Never renamed; a rename is a new role.

grants.description: The permissions this role confers, resolved by value rather than referenced by id.

inherits.description: Roles whose grants are added to this one. Ids, not documents — the graph must not be inlined.

assignable-by.description: Roles permitted to assign this one. Empty means only a global identity-account grant may.
